text: After this you can distinguish power from energy and combine consumption using matching units.

Power expresses the speed of energy use; energy measures the amount consumed. A kilowatt (kW) is a power unit, while a kilowatt-hour (kWh) is an amount of energy. A gigajoule (GJ) is also an energy unit. One kWh equals 0.0036 GJ. For a steady power draw, multiply kW by operating hours to obtain kWh. Convert purchased fuels and electricity to a common energy basis before combining totals.
